title: Hearty Vietnamese Cod Dumplings
description: Fermented, creamy, nostalgic Vietnamese dumplings made with cod, baked in individual mini cocottes for a crusty finish.
instructions: Preheat the oven broiler to high heat.
In a bowl mix the diced cod, rice flour, fermented shrimp paste, green onion, cilantro, lime juice, sesame oil, water, salt and pepper until a cohesive batter forms.
Divide the batter into 4 equal portions.
Place each portion into a preheated individual mini cocotte and smooth the surface.
Arrange the mini cocottes on a baking sheet and place under the broiler.
Broil for 5 to 7 minutes until the tops are golden brown and slightly crispy.
Remove from the broiler and let the dumplings rest for 1 minute.
Serve hot, optionally garnished with extra cilantro or lime wedges.
Enjoy the creamy interior and crunchy exterior of these hearty dumplings.
Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 2 days.
